reasons: Cited text matches the preferred position: §21.1 sets a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000, and expressly states the cap is mutual (no one-sided or uncapped-Customer language).

§21.3 defines 'Excluded Claims' covering confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and because both §21.1 and §21.2 open 'Except for Excluded Claims,' those items sit outside the cap and the damages exclusion as the playbook requires.

§21.2 provides a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and helpfully confirms restoration, replacement services, notification and incident response costs are direct damages; §21.3 confirms Customer's undisputed Fee obligation is not 'damages' — matching the preferred carve-out.

'Fees' (§1.5) captures recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the 12-month basis is substantive rather than illusory; no competing cap was identified in warranty, indemnity or insurance provisions.
Consistent with a compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, the rendered text is unchanged from the original, and both deterministic checks pass.
